title: Cycle Acceptance Criteria Table with Layer-Match Verification
summary: DECIDE produces (or explicitly identifies within `scenarios.md`) a Cycle Acceptance Criteria Table listing each emergent or aggregate acceptance criterion from product-discovery, recording for each the criterion text, the specified verification layer, the verification method (which scenarios compose to cover it), and a layer-match check (does verification exercise the specified layer or stub it out). BUILD gains Step 5.5 — Cycle Criterion Verification — which writes or identifies an integration test at the stated layer for any entry whose layer-match check is "no." The table is required only when product-discovery names emergent, aggregate, or layer-specifying criteria; cycles with only atomic criteria record a one-line judgment instead.
workflow_point: DECIDE (Cycle Acceptance Criteria Table in scenarios.md) and BUILD Step 5.5 (Cycle Criterion Verification)
mechanism: four-column layer-match table bridging aggregate acceptance criteria to scenario-level verification

links.note: the layer-match check operationalizes the Inversion Principle (ADR-055) as a structural prompt for "what layer am I not verifying?"
the table's risk of drifting from product-discovery is mitigated by the supersession workflow (ADR-074) when product-discovery's criteria themselves are revised
